status: FROZEN — all stage thresholds set BEFORE any funnel/backtest result. Any change is a NEW pre-registration and re-incurs the divide-by-N haircut.
mandate: SHADOW pipeline. screener_v2 logs its OWN forward pick ledger head-to-head vs the current live engine. It does NOT touch/replace/feed the live screener, email, or dashboard selection. Promotion to live ONLY on n>=30 forward beat + haircut + explicit go.
survivorship: No point-in-time universe exists -> a from-scratch HISTORICAL funnel/backtest is survivorship-biased and is NOT proof of edge. screener_v2 is validated FORWARD ONLY. Any in-sample funnel is DESCRIPTIVE mechanics, never edge.
anti_look_ahead: Every stage reads bars[0..signal_index] only. Proven by truncation test in pipeline.py self-test.
architecture: GATING+RANKING (reject most of the universe at the gate, THEN rank survivors) — the key difference vs today's SCORING engine.

stage1_trend_template.role: HARD GATE (binary pass/fail) — replaces today's soft Minervini score
rules: MA50, MA150, MA200 all rising over the rising_lookback
MA200 rising for >= 22 trading days (~1 month)
price >= 75% of 52-week high (within 25% of the high)
earnings/growth (CANSLIM): accelerating EPS/revenue + recent positive surprise IF a fundamentals feed exists; else DEFER (return None, never a silent pass)
stage2_liquidity_quality.earnings_overlay: DEFERRED unless fundamentals feed present at run time; reported as deferred, not fabricated

stage3_vcp.role: SETUP GATE (no valid VCP => WATCH, not a buy)
rules: >= 2 successive pullbacks, each shallower than the prior (contraction)
each contraction depth <= 0.75x the prior contraction depth
volume declining into the pivot: pivot 5-bar avg vol <= 0.85x base avg vol
price coiling under a definable pivot/buy-point

vcp_method_frozen.note: Method fully pre-registered by principle 2026-06-30 (reversal 5%, base 60, max-T 6, pivot/base_low anchoring). Corrects the superseded 4% doc: the engine has always run 5% and produced every pick at 5% (4% was never in effect); this ratifies the value in effect and completes the spec (max-T + anchoring). New pre-registered decision -> fresh /N haircut, own forward series.

stage4_rs_rank.role: RANK — take the top decile (trade the STRONGEST, not the merely-qualified)
stage4_rs_rank.rule: IBD-style weighted RS vs SPY; rank ALL stage-3 setups; keep top decile (or top N if the survivor set is small)

rules: not-extended gate (D51, ALREADY VALIDATED) applied at the pivot
entry = pivot breakout WITH volume-confirm >= 1.40x avg
stop = below the VCP base low (structural)
target = measured-move (base depth projected up) or next resistance

haircut.basis: 5 stage gates ablated individually + 1 full pipeline
haircut.rule: in-sample edge / N before any 'survives' claim

ledger.name: screener_v2_picks
ledger.head_to_head: expectancy-led (net/PF/payoff, win% footnote) vs current-engine FORWARD picks; ÷N haircut; n<30 DESCRIPTIVE; FORWARD never blended with HISTORICAL

promotion_rule: v2 stays SHADOW (logs, never trades) until its FORWARD picks beat the current engine's FORWARD picks over n>=30, haircut-applied, AND an explicit go. Until then current engine remains the sole live source of truth.
